ui.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 — Alibaba's September 2026 text-to-image model, ported natively to MLX on Apple Silicon and Candle on NVIDIA CUDA (Windows/Linux). A ~7.1B single-stream flow-matching transformer over a 64-channel latent with a ~7.6B Qwen3-VL language tower, it renders at up to 2752 px on its long edge across seven aspect presets, with true classifier-free guidance and a negative prompt. Three precision tiers — bf16, Q8 and Q4 — install and run on BOTH backends, and a tier here is a whole-pipeline choice: Q4 runs Q4 through the transformer and the language tower alike, which is what brings it within reach of a 24 GB card. Distributed under the Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE AGREEMENT: research and evaluation use only, with a separate commercial licence required from Alibaba. The bf16 tier is downloaded from Qwen's own repository on first use; the Q8 and Q4 tiers are quantized derivatives re-hosted by SceneWorks, each carrying the licence, the attribution notice and a CHANGES.md record of what was changed.
ui.label: Qwen Image 2.1

ui.description: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 Image Klein, the distilled checkpoint: a 5.6B flow-map transformer with its 16x autoencoder, conditioned on the bundled Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct text encoder. Native MLX on Apple Silicon and Candle/CUDA on Windows/Linux NVIDIA; 16 Euler steps, no classifier-free guidance. One ~43.3 GB gated whole-repository download (FLUX Kommunity License); conservative resident memory floor ~32 GB at 1024².
ui.label: FLUX 3 Image Klein

evidence.reason: The provider contract classifies BoundedDecode as StructurallyNotApplicable: SenseNova has no VAE decode phase; its FM head emits RGB patches directly.

The provider contract classifies StagedResidency as StructurallyNotApplicable: SenseNova is one fused dual-path transformer with no separable conditioning component, so there is no phase boundary to release.
The provider contract classifies BoundedDecode as StructurallyNotApplicable: SenseNova has no VAE/decoder phase; the FM head emits RGB patches and unpatchify only reshapes them.
The provider contract classifies StagedResidency as StructurallyNotApplicable: SenseNova is one flat fused dual-path checkpoint; no independently releasable conditioning component exists.

ui.description: Unified multimodal model (NEO-unify, ~16B). Native text-to-image and instruction-based editing with strong prompt following, dense text, and infographics. In Character Studio, drives a *wardrobe-preserving* reference flow: SenseNova carries the tank, jacket, props, tattoos, and hair color from the reference into new scenes very faithfully, but face geometry can drift — best when outfit consistency matters more than face identity (for face-locked identity, pick InstantID or PuLID-FLUX). Heavy: ~42GB bf16, ~50 steps; runs on large-VRAM GPUs and 96GB+ Apple Silicon (MPS).
ui.label: SenseNova-U1 8B

ui.description: zai-org SCAIL-2 character animation: give ordered reference character images and a driving video, and SCAIL-2 animates the supplied characters with the driving motion (the driving clip sets the motion and timing). Built on Wan2.1-14B; native MLX on macOS and native Candle on NVIDIA Windows/Linux admit the same installable q4, q8, and bf16 package variants when installed. Measured Candle floors are 64 GB for q4, 67 GB for q8, and 105 GB for bf16. Runs minutes-per-clip (segmented 14B denoise).
ui.durationHint: Segmented 14B denoise — keep clips at 5s or less. Generates at 16fps; the driving clip sets the motion and timing.
ui.label: SCAIL-2
